tasks.label: Bump version
tasks.detail: Raise the version in manifest.json (required for PRs that change the integration)

tasks.label: Check version bump against main
tasks.detail: The same check CI runs on pull requests
tasks.command: git fetch -q origin main && uv run python scripts/bump_version.py --check "$(git show origin/main:custom_components/populife/manifest.json | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["version"])')"

tasks.label: Panel dev server
tasks.detail: The panel against a mocked Home Assistant

tasks.label: Run all checks
tasks.detail: ruff, mypy and pytest, as in CI
tasks.command: uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy && uv run pytest
